gap.reason: Stage 2 decomposition critic repair: The atom turns the source's 'faculty take final responsibility for external grades' and one-way faculty assignment permissions into a broad 'only faculty may assign external grades' ceiling. That may be a useful responsibility/ownership boundary, but the validated schema has no explicit hook for final responsibility or responsible faculty ownership, and using assignExternalGrade membership as a proxy would overstate the source. Repair should either cite a source that explicitly says external-grade assignment is faculty-only, or add/schema-repair a representation of the external-grade final-responsibility boundary before proposing a property over it.

proposed_atoms.name: ExternalGrade__responsibleFaculty
proposed_atoms.rationale: This field represents the faculty user who takes final responsibility for an external grade.
proposed_atoms.plain_english_summary: Each external grade can record which faculty member is ultimately responsible for it.
proposed_atoms.source_excerpt: Faculty members take final responsibility for external grades.
alternatives_considered: Use assignExternalGrade permission as a proxy for responsibility, rejected because the reviewer said that would overstate the source.
Model Faculty as a separate entity type, rejected because the current schema represents faculty via User.roles.
Add action context responsibleFaculty to assignExternalGrade, rejected because final responsibility is a property of the external grade rather than only one request.
